source_species_detail: Human fibrosarcoma cells with JAK1-, JAK2-, or TYK2-deficient backgrounds
citation_note: A major role for JAK1 in the IL-6 JAK/STAT pathway
evidence_summary: IL-6 activated JAK1, JAK2, TYK2, STAT1, and STAT3; loss of JAK1 greatly reduced gp130 phosphorylation and STAT1/STAT3 activation, while JAK2/TYK2 activation did not replace JAK1.
limitations: No mouse or SCI context; the paper explicitly rejects a simple sequential three-kinase cascade.

source_species_detail: Human fibrosarcoma cells stimulated with IL-6/soluble IL-6R complexes and JAK-deficient derivatives
citation_note: IL-6 gp130-JAK1-SHP2 signaling and acute-phase regulation
evidence_summary: IL-6 receptor/gp130 stimulation led to JAK activation, gp130 phosphorylation, STAT3/STAT1 and SHP2 recruitment; JAK1 was required for SHP2 phosphorylation, and SHP2 linked toward GRB2/RAS/RAF/MAPK.
limitations: Human cell-system evidence; SHP2-to-MAPK is described as a link/branch, not a universal direct kinase chain.

source_species_detail: Conditional gp130 deletion and gp130 Delta/Delta Stat-binding-site mutant mice; primary mouse mammary epithelial cells and COS-7 assays
citation_note: Mammary gland remodeling depends on gp130 through Stat3 and MAPK
evidence_summary: Loss of gp130 from mouse mammary epithelium abolished Stat3 activity and reduced p44/42 MAPK; loss of gp130 Stat-binding sites separated the canonical Stat3 branch from retained SHP2/Jak2-linked signaling.
limitations: Mouse mammary remodeling is a comparator context, not SCI-specific evidence; EGFR crosstalk contributes to some Stat3 activation.

source_species_detail: Mouse haptoglobin promoter and gp130/STAT3 signaling system
citation_note: STAT3 mediates IL-6 receptor signaling in mouse acute-phase gene regulation
evidence_summary: STAT3 was activated by the IL-6 receptor signal-transducing subunit gp130 and mediated IL-6-dependent acute-phase promoter activity.
limitations: Promoter/activation system rather than receiver-cell SCI context.
